refuter.evidence: Attack: a domain screen keyed on the sign rather than the value would treat a negative zero as negative and return 0 through ArgumentError. rzero.cob (rzero-002, EXIT 0): ANNUITY (-0 2), (-0.0 W-N), (- W-Z 2) over PIC S9V9 display, COMP-3 and COMP, (W-Z * -1 2) and (- ZERO 2) each print 0.500000000 = 1/2, the RV1 value for argument-1 zero. ANNUITY (0 W-P2) with PIC 9PP = 100 prints 0.010000000. Negative values remain undefined (A.2.2 AR4), as the reader said. cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.2 AR4 (reader's line); OK §1985:I.1.6.
